Terrace.scout uses v_eq itself rather than v_eq - t_i s_i v_eq as the kernel-direction basis vector and never states rank two explicitly.

lemma springs (v:ℕ→ Bowl (C.labels.level 5)) (hv:Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 (Stem5 (U#))))
    (hk:Tendsto (fun i=> hueK A (Stern V i) • s i (v i)) atTop (𝓝 0))(hw: Tendsto (fun i=> hueK A (Stern V i)*Lease U# hG (v i)) atTop (𝓝 0)) : Prosper V hG a s:=by
    let x(i):= hueK (A) (Stern V i); have hP(i:ℕ): 0<x i:=wake ..; have hC:Tendsto x atTop atTop:= ((Zn.awe (by norm_num : 0 < (1/5:ℝ))).comp (hrate _ hG)|>.comp ( (Sstar (A)).comp hq.growth))
    have hx : Tendsto (fun i=> s i (v i)) atTop (𝓝 0):=by
        have he := (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hC).smul hk; rw[zero_smul] at he; exact he.congr (fun i=> inv_smul_smul₀ (hP i).ne' _)
    obtain ⟨U,t,hU,hT,hK⟩:= lensP hZ H hb hr hq K θ hG hp
    let B':= LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap U; let f:=LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Vbase a.spin); let t'(i):=LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (t i)
    have ht:Tendsto t' atTop (𝓝 B'):=by refine fitV (E:=↥(TableOne a.spin)) (H:=↥(Bowl (U#))) t' B' ?_; exact hT
    have hr: f.comp B'=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _:= ContinuousLinearMap.ext hU
    have hR:∀ᶠ i in atTop, (s i).comp (t' i)=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _:= hK.mono fun i hi=>ContinuousLinearMap.ext hi
    let F':= (U#); let F₀:= Stem5 (U#); let ξ:= Lease (U#) hG
    have hh:= scout (H:=↥(TableOne a.spin)) (E:=↥(Bowl (U#))) f s B' t' F₀ v ht hr hR hv hx (Stem5_alive _ hG) (fun y=> Stem5_kernel (a:=a.spin) y hG)
    obtain ⟨m,M,h₁,h₂⟩:= expenses (H:=↥(TableOne a.spin)) (E:=↥(Bowl (U#))) f s B' t' F₀ v x ξ ht hR hv hh (Stem5_alive _ hG) (fun p=> Stem5_kernel (a:=a.spin) p hG) hr (by exact hk) (by exact hw)
    refine ⟨hh,m,M,h₁,h₂.1,?_⟩; change ∀ e:ℝ,0<e → ∀ᶠ i in atTop,∀ y, ‖x i*(m i (s i y) - ξ y)‖ ≤ _; exact h₂.2

proof_context.conclusion: lensP gives right inverses t_i with s_i t_i = id converging to B' with s B' = id; scout gives s_i -> Vbase; expenses gives functionals m_i with the Prosper rate.

lemma scout (hh:∀ y:E,f y=0↔ ∃ a:ℝ,y=a • x) : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 f):=by
    obtain ⟨A,hA⟩:= plumage f U x h hh hr
    let V(i):= (u i).comp f + A.smulRight (w i)
    have he₁ : Tendsto V atTop (𝓝 (1:E→L[ℝ] E)):=by
       refine fitV _ _ (fun y=>?_)
       exact (by change Tendsto (fun i=>(u i) (f y)+A y • (w i)) atTop (𝓝 y); nth_rw 3 [hA y]; exact (beak u (fun _=>f y) U (f y) he tendsto_const_nhds).add (hp.const_smul _))
    refine revise V v f he₁ ?_
    apply fitV; intro y; have hz:= hx.const_smul (A y); have hu: Tendsto (fun i=> f y+ A y • v i (w i)) atTop (𝓝 (f y)):=by simpa only[smul_zero,add_zero] using hz.const_add (f y)
    refine hu.congr' (hR.mono fun i hi=>?_)
    change _=v i (u i (f y)+ A y • w i); rw [map_add,map_smul,show v i (u i (f y))= _ from DFunLike.congr_fun hi (f y)]; rfl

proof_context.conclusion: The bases t_i f + A(.) w_i (right inverse plus kernel-direction vector) converge to the identity, giving s_i -> f.

lemma spend (e:ℕ→ℝ)(ρ:E→L[ℝ]ℝ) (he:Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 U))(hR:∀ᶠ i in atTop,(v i).comp (u i)=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H) (hp:Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 x))(hv:Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 f))(h:x≠0)(hh:∀ y:E,f y=0 ↔ ∃ a:ℝ,y=a • x)(hr:f.comp U=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H) (hV:Tendsto (fun i=>e i • v i (w i)) atTop (𝓝 0))(hL:Tendsto (fun i=> e i*ρ (w i)) atTop (𝓝 0)): ∃ (μ:ℕ → H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m:H →L[ℝ] ℝ), Tendsto μ atTop (𝓝 m) ∧ Tendsto (fun i=>e i • ((μ i).comp (v i)-ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=by
    exact ⟨fun i=>ρ.comp (u i),ρ.comp U,((show Continuous (fun x:H→L[ℝ] E=>ρ.comp x) from continuous_const.clm_comp continuous_id)).continuousAt.tendsto.comp he,permute f v U u x w _ e he hR hp hv h hh hr hV hL⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The functionals are mu_i = rho . t_i, i.e. lambda_i = rho_tr t_i.

lemma rungs : Prosper V h H s:=by
    let k:= Stern V; let x i:= (A).clock.hatBeta (k i); let g:= medium L X Z ∘ k
    obtain ⟨hx,he⟩:= aspiring P h hb hu hz hp hL; have hℓ : Tendsto k atTop atTop:= (Sstar A).comp hq.growth
    refine springs hz P hb ht hq hM θ h hY g (hx.comp hℓ) ?_ (he.comp hℓ)
    let F:=(A); apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr; have hb':= legacy P h θ K ht hM hb hu hz hp Hδ hr hA hL hq H' HF hq' hJ hP ho hY 1
    refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun i=> norm_nonneg _) ?_ (show Tendsto _ _ _ from tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mp hb')
    filter_upwards [hℓ.eventually ((hrate F h).eventually ((ferry (waveM (1/5:ℝ))) 1 zero_lt_one))] with i hi; change ‖hueK F (k i) • ((s i (g i)).val:Axis→ (Cells.standard C).Field 5)‖ ≤ ‖(H! _ ^ (1:ℕ)) • ((s i (g i)).val:Axis→ (Cells.standard C).Field 5)‖; rw [norm_smul,norm_smul,pow_one,Real.norm_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ hueK F (k i) from Zn.wake ..|>.le),Real.norm_of_nonneg (bell ..|>.le)]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hi.2.trans (Real.rpow_one _).le) (norm_nonneg _)

proof_context.conclusion: Prosper holds for the actual sequence s.
